opening.argument: The speaker presents BitClub Network as an online investment opportunity built around purchased mining pools and promised earnings. The “Daily Mining profit share!” slide lists Pool 1 at $500, Pool 2 at $1,000, and Pool 3 at $2,000, alongside daily profit-share figures. The speaker also ties team purchases to percentage earnings, urges viewers to join and tell others in pursuit of exceptionally large returns, and gives direct sign-up instructions requiring the sponsor name “love or lovely 2015.” Although the presentation does not promise a fixed seven-, ten-, or twenty-percent return, it still promotes daily mining proceeds, bonuses, recruitment, and registration. The failed website demonstration does not independently establish that the advertised mining, earnings, or sign-up process occurred.
